Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step. After correctly retrieving the birth dates (Keith Bostic: January 17, 1961; Jerry Glanville: October 14, 1941), the Planner incorrectly concluded that "1961 is later than 1941, so Jerry Glanville is younger." In reality, a person born in 1961 is older than a person born in 1941. The Planner confused the concept of "later birth year" with "younger age," leading to the wrong conclusion that Jerry Glanville is younger when Keith Bostic is actually the younger one.
